papers.title: Causal inference of glucocorticoid signaling in non-small cell lung cancer: integrating Mendelian randomization, single-cell transcriptomics, and imaging data
papers.source_location: Methods: Univariate MR, Data Sources, Selection of IVs, sensitivity analyses; Data availability; Discussion limitations
papers.exposure_construct: cis-eQTL of a broad glucocorticoid-related gene set, not exogenous glucocorticoid use or abuse
papers.design: GTEx/eQTLGen molecular exposure GWAS with FinnGen lung-cancer outcomes and independent cancer GWAS; molecular/clinical triangulation
papers.transferable: Molecular MR plus colocalization, independent outcome replication and tissue-aware evidence
papers.limitations: A broad GRG list includes indirect genes; expression perturbation does not estimate drug dose, receptor activation or abuse. LD thresholds and low-power pleiotropy tests need independent appraisal rather than verbatim reuse.
papers.code_status: No GitHub link or Code availability section identified in the publisher text read; this is not proof that no code exists

papers.title: Proteome-wide Mendelian randomization identifies protein associations and therapeutic targets for B-cell malignancy
papers.source_location: Publication metadata and abstract; PMC full text was access-challenged
papers.design: Proteome-wide MR across B-cell malignancies, with single-cell, Bayesian colocalization and clinical-trial evidence integration
papers.transferable: Rank candidate targets by convergent genetic and biological support
papers.limitations: Abstract supports design-level mapping only; exact estimator, variant filters and overlap handling require full methods. Protein abundance is not administered drug exposure.
papers.code_status: Not assessed from abstract; no author code repository identified in this read

papers.title: Plasma proteome-wide Mendelian randomization reveals multi-ancestry drug targets for gastric cancer
papers.source_location: Publisher sections 2.3-2.6 indexed full-text passages; PubMed PMID 42147228 confirms date/DOI
papers.design: Ancestry-stratified proteome-wide MR with gastric-cancer GWAS, SMR/HEIDI and Bayesian colocalization
papers.transferable: Separate ancestry-specific analyses and use molecular QTL plus coloc
papers.limitations: Sparse East Asian pQTL can limit instruments. Ancestry-specific significance differences do not themselves prove effect heterogeneity. HEIDI non-significance does not prove absence of linkage or pleiotropy.
papers.code_status: No verified author GitHub repository found in read sections; exact code availability remains unassessed

papers.title: Simulated sample splitting approach to address biases due to instrument selection and participant overlap in two-sample Mendelian Randomization studies
papers.source_location: Abstract; Methods Overview/Technical details; Data Availability; Discussion
papers.exposure_construct: Generic GWAS traits, illustrated with BMI/T2D
papers.design: Conditional simulation of independent pseudo-sample summary statistics; 2-/3-split MR with IVW or MR-RAPS; simulations and UK Biobank examples
papers.transferable: Modular sensitivity route when variant selection and estimation share cohorts
papers.limitations: Requires suitable approximately independent variants and sufficiently many instruments; simulated splitting can weaken instruments and costs computation. It does not repair an invalid exposure definition or all pleiotropy.

papers.title: Fast and flexible joint fine-mapping of multiple traits via the Sum of Single Effects model
papers.source_location: Abstract; Code availability in publisher PDF; author mvsusieR README
papers.exposure_construct: Joint genetic effects across related traits; not an MR exposure
papers.design: mvSuSiE joint multi-trait fine-mapping with learned effect-sharing patterns; simulation and blood-cell trait examples
papers.transferable: Joint fine-mapping of biologically related traits when covariance/summary inputs are appropriate
papers.limitations: Multi-trait fine-mapping and multi-ancestry fine-mapping are different designs. Fine-mapped variants do not establish trait mediation or a pharmacological effect.
papers.code_status: Author software and archived paper resources explicitly released

papers.title: Genome-wide fine-mapping improves identification of causal variants
papers.source_location: Abstract; Method overview; Code availability; Change history
papers.exposure_construct: Generic complex-trait variant architecture; not drug exposure
papers.design: Functionally informed genome-wide Bayesian mixture fine-mapping with SBayesRC; local/global credible sets and sample-size planning
papers.transferable: Alternative to selecting only genome-wide significant regional windows
papers.limitations: Needs compatible genome-wide summary statistics, LD reference, computational resources and convergence checks; heavier than a small cis-target analysis. PIP is model-dependent evidence, not functional proof.
papers.code_status: GCTB implementation and archives explicitly released

papers.title: Multi-ancestry colocalization approaches
papers.source_location: Abstract; Results Overview; Data Availability; Discussion
papers.exposure_construct: Shared regional genetic signal across traits/ancestries
papers.design: Integrates SuSiEx/MsCAVIAR fine-mapping with coloc/eCAVIAR; four approaches assessed in simulations and T2D-pQTL example
papers.transferable: Use ancestry-specific summaries and matched LD instead of applying a single reference to a multi-ancestry mixture
papers.limitations: Needs ancestry-stratified data; unbalanced ancestry sizes can reduce signal discovery. Different credible-set and posterior definitions must remain explicit. MACA repository DESCRIPTION contains an unresolved license placeholder; reference only, do not vendor.
papers.code_status: Author code explicitly released; software license not established

papers.title: Design and interpretation of eQTL-GWAS colocalisation studies: Lessons from a large-scale evaluation
papers.source_location: Abstract; Materials and methods: Colocalisation/QC and significance; Data Availability
papers.exposure_construct: eQTL-GWAS shared signals across tissues and cell types
papers.design: Large-scale analysis of public and in-house colocalization results, simulations, sensitivity and regulatory evidence
papers.transferable: Audit missing shared variants, contextual tissue choice, prior sensitivity and multiple colocalizing genes
papers.limitations: Co-regulated genes can colocalize at the same locus; H4 alone does not select the functional mediator. Single-causal-variant implementation and differing sample sizes limit conclusions.
papers.code_status: Author code explicitly released; GitHub harmonization and GitLab analysis repositories

papers.title: Challenges and future directions for Mendelian randomization
papers.source_location: Publisher Abstract and article metadata; full text subscription preview
papers.transferable: Require empirical support for assumptions and integrate independently informative designs
papers.limitations: This is not a new estimator, empirical drug safety result, or a substitute for original method papers.
papers.code_status: No analysis module proposed from an abstract-only Perspective

papers.title: A robust and accurate two-sample Mendelian randomization method with a large number of genetic variants
papers.source_location: Early accepted version abstract; publication metadata. Full methods/code unavailable in page read.
papers.exposure_construct: Generic two-sample MR; illustrated with lean mass/lipids
papers.design: MRZ mixture model of IV-outcome z-scores to separate valid, correlated-pleiotropic and uncorrelated-pleiotropic instruments
papers.transferable: Candidate for later high-dimensional robust MR evaluation
papers.limitations: Only an accepted early version and abstract were accessible. Do not implement from the abstract or treat its claims as benchmark replication. Applicability to sparse cis instruments remains unassessed.
papers.code_status: No verified author code repository identified; watchlist/reference only

papers.title: Cross-ancestry proteome-wide Mendelian randomization prioritizes 12 plasma protein candidates for breast cancer risk
papers.source_location: Author preprint abstract and PubMed identifiers
papers.design: Cross-ancestry protein MR with colocalization, independent proteomics and polygenic-score corroboration
papers.transferable: Explicitly separate ancestry replication, heterogeneity, subtype and orthogonal evidence
papers.limitations: Preprint evidence only; instruments largely sourced from European proteomics. Polygenic-score corroboration does not establish a pharmacological effect.
papers.code_status: Code availability not verified from abstract

papers.title: Assessing the role of cortisol in cancer: a wide-ranged Mendelian randomisation study
papers.source_location: Abstract: Methods and Results; publication metadata
papers.exposure_construct: Genetically predicted morning endogenous plasma cortisol
papers.design: Three cortisol-associated variants, two-sample fixed-effect IVW and cancer-source meta-analysis
papers.transferable: Shows that cortisol/cancer MR already exists and that endogenous cortisol is a distinct question
papers.limitations: Few variants restrict sensitivity analyses; not a 2026 paper and not an exogenous glucocorticoid misuse study.
